steps.name: V-1: with an owner that cannot create roles the start command stops before the API starts
steps.detail: roles refused: V-1 failed: empathia_owner cannot create roles. Stop: do not run the API as the owner (docs/operations/RENDER_DEPLOYMENT.md §V-1)

steps.name: the start command, as written in the Blueprint, prepares an empty database and brings the API up in production, demonstration mode
steps.detail: 35 migrations · authMode demo · 18 variables from the Blueprint

steps.name: the deployment check passes against it: permissions, unauthorized access, isolation, persistence, cross-origin, reset
a restart: the same command runs again and changes nothing; a sandbox opened before it opens with its key after it and reads the same record; a session issued before it is still good
steps.detail: session from the key 200 · same thread true · earlier session 200 · 35 migrations, 4 sandboxes, unchanged

steps.name: the self-check: off as declared, nothing runs; switched on, the deployment check runs inside the service against its own address and its lines are in the log
the database holds sandboxes and nothing else: no other tenant, nobody with a password or a provider subject
the runtime role is not the owner: it cannot read the sandbox table, change the setting, or create a tenant
steps.detail: permission denied ×3 of 3 · rooms visible without a tenant: 0

smoke.title: the service is up in demonstration mode, on a named release, with its database reachable
smoke.detail: status ok · authMode demo · release [object Object] · migrations 35

smoke.title: nothing but the demonstration is served; no token and a made-up token get 401
smoke.detail: sign-in 404 · public form 404 · no token 401 · made-up token 401 bad token signature

smoke.title: a sandbox opens with a key, fifteen synthetic people and one installed room; its first session is the installer’s
correct permissions: the installer records a mounting and a field move; the systems engineer approves the move

attempted unauthorized access by role is refused with a reason: the designer, the installer on their own move and on commissioning, the requestor, the commissioning engineer on people; and the register gate holds for the systems engineer
smoke.detail: 403 designer may not record how a device is mounted (needs work.evidence or field.scan) | own move 403 | 403 installer may not move a room to COMMISSIONING (needs plan.compile) | 403 | 403 | gate 422

smoke.title: a wrong key, an unknown sandbox, another sandbox’s key and a privileged role get no session
smoke.detail: wrong key 401 · unknown 401 · B’s key 401 · architect/founder/secadmin 400/400/400

smoke.title: one sandbox’s session cannot read or write the other’s room
smoke.detail: same code, two rooms: true · B sees its own (mounted 0) · B→A read 404 · A→B read 404 · B→A write 404

smoke.title: a new session made from the key alone, as a different person, reads the same field record and thread
smoke.detail: mounted 1 · approved moves 1 · as built FM-0001 · refusals on the record 4

smoke.title: a binary upload and an oversized note are refused; a short text note is kept
the demo site’s origin is allowed, with PUT; any other origin is not
smoke.detail: https://empathia-demo-next.onrender.com: https://empathia-demo-next.onrender.com [GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE] · other origin: not allowed

smoke.title: reset: the old session and the old key stop at once; the new sandbox has nothing recorded
smoke.detail: reset 201 · old session 401 · old key 401 · new sandbox mounted 0

limits: Local cluster without TLS (PGSSLMODE rehearsed as disable); no Render proxy, container or free-plan sleep; the cluster superuser stands in for Render's default database user; runtime-role passwords are the local cluster's. V-1 on Render Postgres, the image build and the edge are seen only on Render.
